```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# install.packages("shiny")
# install.packages("dplyr")
# install.packages("ggplot2")
# install.packages("here")

library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)

# Loading data
oe_data   <- load(here("Data", "shiny_data.RData"))
ucdb_data <- load(here("Data", "built_ucdb.RData"))

```

## UI



```{r ui}
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("OE Data Shiny Web App"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("year", "Select Year:", choices = unique(oe_data_shi$Year)),
      selectInput("location", "Select City:", choices = unique(oe_data_shi$Location)),
      selectInput("region2", "Select Comparison Group:", choices = unique(oe_data_shi$Region2)),
      radioButtons("section", "Select Section:", choices = c("GDP per capita (PPP)", "Employment structure"))
    ),
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("gdpPlot"),
      tableOutput("dataTable")
    )
  )
)


```

## Server


```{r sever, echo=FALSE}

server <- function(input, output) {
  filteredData <- reactive({
    oe_data_shi %>%
      filter(Year == input$year & Location == input$location)
  })
  
  comparisonGroupData <- reactive({
    oe_data_shi %>%
      filter(Region2 == input$region2)
  })
  
  output$dataTable <- renderTable({
    filteredData()
  })
  
  output$gdpPlot <- renderPlot({
    if (input$section == "GDP per capita (PPP)") {
      data <- oe_data_shi %>%
        filter(Location == input$location | Region2 == input$region2)
      
      ggplot(data, aes(x = Year, y = GDP_per_capita_PPP, color = Location)) +
        geom_line() +
        geom_point() +
        labs(title = "GDP per Capita PPP over Years", x = "Year", y = "GDP per Capita PPP") +
        theme_minimal() +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("gray" = "gray", input$location = "blue"))
    } else if (input$section == "Employment structure") {
      data <- filteredData()
      
      ggplot(data, aes(x = "", y = 100)) +
        geom_bar(aes(y = Public_Services_Emp_Pct, fill = "Public Services"), stat = "identity") +
        geom_bar(aes(y = Industry_Emp_Pct, fill = "Industry"), stat = "identity") +
        geom_bar(aes(y = Financial_Busines_Serices_Emp_Pct, fill = "Financial & Business Services"), stat = "identity") +
        geom_bar(aes(y = Consumer_services_Emp_Pct, fill = "Consumer Services"), stat = "identity") +
        geom_bar(aes(y = Agriculture_Emp_Pct, fill = "Agriculture"), stat = "identity") +
        geom_bar(aes(y = Transport_Information_Communic_Services_Emp_Pct, fill = "Transport & Info/Comm Services"), stat = "identity") +
        labs(title = "Employment Structure", x = "Category", y = "Percentage") +
        coord_flip() +
        theme_minimal() +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("Public Services" = "red", "Industry" = "blue", "Financial & Business Services" = "green", "Consumer Services" = "purple", "Agriculture" = "orange", "Transport & Info/Comm Services" = "brown"))
    }
  })
}

```

```{r deploy}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

```
